name: twitch-social-mcp
description: Twitch (social): me, publish_text, reply_comment, delete. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_twitch_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_twitch_client_id.description: Twitch app client id (dev.twitch.tv console); also sent as the Client-Id header required on every Helix call.

platform_mcp_twitch_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_twitch_client_secret.description: Twitch app client secret (form body of the refresh request to https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token).

platform_mcp_twitch_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_twitch_refresh_token.description: User refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scopes user:write:chat and moderator:manage:chat_messages. 'Because refresh tokens may change, your app should safely store the new refresh token': the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/twitch.json (mode 0600).

platform_mcp_twitch_broadcaster_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_BROADCASTER_ID
platform_mcp_twitch_broadcaster_id.description: User id of the channel whose chat is used (GET /helix/users?login=…).

platform_mcp_twitch_sender_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TWITCH_SENDER_ID
platform_mcp_twitch_sender_id.description: User id of the token's user (GET /helix/users with the token); sender of messages and moderator for delete.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Get Users without ids returns the token's user (account.data[0]: id, login, display_name).

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: Sends a chat message (max 500 characters) to config broadcaster_id's chat. A message that fails AutoMod or chat settings answers 200 with raw.is_sent=false and raw.drop_reason — check is_sent.

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.description: Chat reply: `comment_id` is the chat message id being replied to (reply_parent_message_id). Check raw.is_sent.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Deletes ONE chat message (`post_id` = message id; created within the last 6 hours, not the broadcaster's or another moderator's). message_id is always sent: without it Twitch 'removes all messages in the broadcaster's chat room'.
